title.ru: at the end или in the end
title.en: at the end or in the end
title.es: at the end o in the end

pattern.en: Pay at the end of the month.
In the end, we stayed at home.
The shop is at the end of the street.
We argued, but in the end we agreed.
pattern.ru: Мы спорили, но в конце концов договорились.

text.ru: at the end of — буквально конец чего-то во времени или пространстве: at the end of the film, at the end of the road. После него обычно of + существительное. in the end — «в итоге, в конце концов», после долгого процесса или раздумий, и обычно без of: In the end, we took a taxi.
text.en: at the end of + noun = the final part of something (at the end of the film). in the end = finally, after a process (In the end we took a taxi).
text.es: at the end of = al final de; in the end = al final, por fin.

rule.formula: at the end of + что — в конце чего-то · in the end — в итоге, в конце концов

head: смысл
пример
rows: at the end of the day
In the end, it was fine.

exercises.en: Turn left ___ the end of the corridor.
We looked at many flats and ___ the end we bought a house.
exercises.ru: Мы посмотрели много квартир, а в итоге купили дом.

exercises.en: I'm paid at the end ___ the month.
It was difficult, but ___ the end everything was OK.
exercises.ru: Было трудно, но в итоге всё было хорошо.

exercises.en: The answers are at the end of the book.

prompt.ru: Расскажите историю, которая закончилась неожиданно: что было at the end и что в итоге (in the end).
prompt.en: Tell a story with an unexpected ending: what happened at the end and in the end.
prompt.es: Cuenta una historia con final inesperado: at the end / in the end.

exercises.template: At the end of … In the end …
exercises.sample: At the end of the trip we lost our bags. In the end, an airline sent them home.
